ideas.name: Personal Tech Debt Tracker
ideas.problem: Consumers accumulate a 'tech debt' of outdated software, devices, and subscriptions that are no longer useful or secure, leading to wasted money and potential security risks. This app helps users identify, track, and manage their personal technology lifecycle.
ideas.monetization: Freemium with a one-time purchase for unlimited device tracking and automated reminders for end-of-life products. Potential for affiliate partnerships with tech recycling services.
